newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kingspan says buys UK firm for 9.5 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Kingspan says buys UK firm for 9.5 mln stg.

text.p: Irish building materials firm Kingspan Plc said on Tuesday it was buying British insulation products company Kooltherm from Sentrachem for 9.5 million stg.
Kingspan said it would pay 6.2 million stg in cash on completion and would discharge a loan from the vendor of 3.3 million stg.
Kingspan said the acquisition was expected to be immediately earnings enhancing.
It said Kooltherm had made profits before interest and tax of 875,000 stg and profits before tax of 329,000 stg in the 15 months to end-June 1995.
"Kingspan believes that trading in Kooltherm in the period since June 30, 1995 has improved considerably," Kingspan said.

It said Kooltherm had excellent growth potential and would provide an opportunity to introduce the acquired technology into other divisions of Kingspan and allow Kingspan to sell its products through Kooltherm's distribution outlets in the Far East.
